calls.title: Technical Screen - Merwan Stevens
calls.summary: The discussion primarily addressed SDK integration issues, including the need to update the placeholder client key from GrowthBook for accurate authentication. Participants highlighted the importance of replacing hard-coded test values with dynamic user attributes to enhance experiment targeting. An API host error was diagnosed as a configuration mismatch, emphasizing that self-hosted setups should utilize custom API URLs. Additionally, the team underscored the value of utilizing GrowthBook documentation effectively and promoting real-time communication to expedite problem resolution. Insights into the company's culture revealed a small team size that enhances role visibility and an unlimited PTO policy that supports work-life balance.
calls.keywords: client key, SDK connection, GrowthBook, dynamic attributes, API host, support engineering
